answer: Start from vesting bond with cliff and linear release. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the quill up to the light, weigh the inlet of the attack, and keep the grove of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
